verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak stacked layout. The yellow blocks sit on top of the photo of the woman and hide part of it. The headline has lost its yellow backing and floats on plain white. The second photo is jammed into the left side of a large, empty yellow box, and the white spaces around it look unplanned. In the original, the 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' labels sat together; here they are split apart. In B the gap between them is wider and 'FREYA ANOUK' is pushed against the bottom edge. A's slightly tighter grouping makes it marginally less bad, though its small black bar nearly touches the upper label.
